title: ESPC launches mobile app with 72-hour property listing advantage
summary:
Scottish property portal ESPC has released a mobile application that provides users with access to property listings up to 72 hours before they appear on national portals. The app covers properties across Edinburgh, the Lothians, Fife, the Borders and Dumfries & Galloway.

title: Rent guarantor contracts face legal uncertainty
summary:
Updated government guidance on the Tenant Fees Act has raised questions about the validity of professional rent guarantor contracts issued before the Renters' Rights Act came into force on 1 May 2025. The Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government has warned landlords and letting agents that existing guarantor agreements may be affected by the new legislation.

title: Slough proposes licensing scheme for 17,000 rental properties
summary:
Slough Borough Council has launched a consultation on plans to introduce comprehensive licensing schemes that would regulate approximately 17,000 rental properties across the town. The proposed schemes would require landlords to pay £950 per property for a five-year HMO licence and £750 for a selective licence covering other rental properties.

title: UK asking prices fall 1% in July as market faces headwinds
summary:
Average asking prices for newly-listed homes in the UK dropped by 1% in July to £372,359, representing a sharper decline than the 0.2% average recorded over the past decade. Rightmove attributed the fall to mortgage rate increases, political uncertainty, the World Cup and persistent heatwaves affecting buyer demand.

title: Mortgage lenders tighten service charge criteria for flats
summary:
Banks are increasingly rejecting mortgage applications for flats where annual service charges exceed 1% of the property's value. The threshold represents a tightening of lending criteria, down from a previous benchmark of 2%.

title: Whitegates acquires Huddersfield agency Harvey & Ryall
summary:
Whitegates has acquired independent estate agency Harvey & Ryall in Huddersfield, expanding the presence of franchise owners Chan and Kashmir Khangura across West Yorkshire. The acquisition transfers Harvey & Ryall's property portfolio to Whitegates Huddersfield, with the franchise stating that vendors, landlords, buyers and tenants will maintain access to services through the wider Whitegates network.

title: Regional cities offer more accessible property ladder entry
summary:
Research from Savills has identified the most affordable UK cities for first-time buyers, with Stoke-on-Trent leading with a flat price-to-income ratio of 2.5 and average flat prices of £88,448. The analysis comes as London deposits reach approximately £130,000, prompting graduates to consider regional alternatives with stronger affordability metrics.

title: Rental market survey: five cities across England and Scotland
summary:
A survey of rental properties across five cities in England and Scotland reveals monthly rental rates ranging from £950 to £1,750, reflecting regional variations in the buy-to-let market. Properties surveyed include developments in Milton Keynes, Liverpool, Norwich, Southampton and Glasgow.

title: Specialist lender approves Glasgow flat above pub
summary:
A specialist mortgage lender has completed a buy-to-let transaction for a Glasgow flat situated above commercial premises, after the application was initially declined under standard lending criteria. The one-bedroom property generates a yield of 7.9%.
